features.name: Add several lines to an order

scenarios.title: Create an order with two products
scenarios.setup: Signed in as Agent, on the Orders page
steps: Type "Office restock (shakedown k3x9 F1.S1)" in Reference
Click Add line and choose Blue mug × 2
Click Add line and choose Red mug × 1
scenarios.expected: The order is listed with 3 items

db.query: select l.product, l.quantity from order_lines l join orders o on o.id = l.order_id where o.reference like '%(shakedown k3x9 F1.S1)%'

scenarios.title: Remove one line from a saved order
scenarios.setup: F1.S1's order, with Blue mug × 2 and Red mug × 1
steps: Open the order "Office restock (shakedown k3x9 F1.S1)"
Click Remove on the Red mug row
scenarios.expected: Only Blue mug × 2 is listed after reload

db.query: select l.product, l.quantity, l.deleted_at from order_lines l join orders o on o.id = l.order_id where o.reference like '%(shakedown k3x9 F1.S1)%'
db.actual: 2 rows: Blue mug × 2, and the removed Red mug × 1 still there

scenarios.actual: The sidebar shows one row, but a reload brings the Red mug back
scenarios.why: A line the agent removed still ships to the customer

scenarios.title: Quantity of zero
scenarios.setup: Signed in as Agent, on the Orders page
steps: Click Add line and choose Blue mug
scenarios.expected: An error under Quantity, and nothing stored
scenarios.risk: StoreOrderRequest.php:24 has no minimum on quantity
scenarios.actual: Typing 0 empties the whole line row, so the scenario can't reach Save
scenarios.evidence: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'product') at OrderSidebar.tsx:112
scenarios.why: An agent who mistypes a quantity loses the row and has to start it again

shots.note: The line row disappeared when 0 was typed, so there was nothing left to save
